subject: Math
text_verbatim: Chapter 1 Numberland Adventures: Up to 999 Look closely, Babloo. Our modern clock has numbers from 1 to 12, right? Yes, but the grandfather clock has symbols instead of numbers. Roman numerals use symbols instead of regular numbers: I stands for 1 V stands for 5 X stands for 10 To make other numbers, we combine these symbols: II = 2 (two ones) IV = 4 (one before five) VI = 6 (five and one) Roman Numerals 1-12 1 I One 2 II Two 3 III Three 4 IV Four 5 V Five 6 VI Six 7 VII Seven 8 VIII Eight 9 IX Nine 10 X Ten 11 XI Eleven 12 XII Twelve Practice Questions Let's change these numbers to the other form. a. IV = ___ b. 10 = ___ c. 7 = ___ d. XI = ___ Discovery Playground Roman Numeral Clock • Your teacher will provide you with a cardboard. Cut a large 26

exercises.instruction_verbatim: Let's change these numbers to the other form. a. IV = ___ b. 10 = ___ c. 7 = ___ d. XI = ___
exercises.answer_key: a. IV = 4; b. 10 = X; c. 7 = VII; d. XI = 11
